build_ensemble_with_random_propagation: build a BasicEnsemble with random_model propagation to sample predictions from random models per batch element
build_ensemble_with_expectation_propagat: build a BasicEnsemble with expectation propagation to compute mean predictions across all ensemble members
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the ensemble and aggregate predictions using the configured propagation method
compute_ensemble_loss: compute the average loss across all ensemble members during training with per-model metadata
evaluate_ensemble_score: evaluate the ensemble by computing average scores across all members for given inputs and targets
